Waitlist

Waitlist only. The desk is not accepting paid work.

Version one is a waitlist. The desk is not accepting paid work, manuscripts, or mail. Joining means you want to hear when a real submission path opens.

Nothing on this form is posted to a server. Submitting it opens an email in your own mail app. The direct address below does the same thing with an empty letter.

Waitlist email

waitlist@strangerthoughts.example

This is a placeholder address. Mail sent to it will not be delivered until a real mailbox is connected.

Tell the desk what you are holding

All three fields are required. Describe the page. Do not paste the whole piece.

A few sentences on the kind of page, and what you hope a stranger notices. This is a description, not the submission.

When a real mailbox replaces the placeholder, this page will say so in the address block above. Until then, treat the waitlist as a draft of the door.

Stranger Thoughts is a reading desk. A real human, not an AI, reads submissions once the waitlist opens. Version one is waitlist only: no prices, no payment, and no donations.
